why: The sim scored 1.7 points a game below actual totals in 2025 and 2.0 in 2026. Fitted on 2025, the correction cut the 2026 bias to -0.3 and the 2026 totals miss from 10.56 to 10.39.
not_adopted: Settings tuned on 2025 (wider team effects, less prior-season weight, slower recency decay, less defensive shrinkage), a margin calibration, a home-field weight and the FTN matchup interactions all failed to improve 2026. See validation.json.
